title: Lulu & Barnes & Noble Press Margin Errors: How to Fix Your Interior | SparkPrep
h1: How to fix margin errors on Lulu and Barnes & Noble Press
description: Lulu or Barnes & Noble Press flagged text too close to the page edge. See the 0.5" safety margin, why it matters, and how to fix your interior quickly.
lead: Lulu and Barnes & Noble Press both want a clear half inch around your text. Here's how to give it to them.
error: Content is outside the safety margin
errorNote: Paraphrased. Each printer words this a little differently.
why:
Pages are trimmed after printing and the inside edge curves into the spine. To keep words from being cut or lost, Lulu and Barnes & Noble Press want everything, including page numbers and headers, at least 0.5" from every trim edge.

The usual cause is a manuscript set up with Word's default page and margins, or pictures and page numbers pushed toward the edge.
manual: Open your manuscript in Word (or InDesign).
Set the page size to your exact trim size (Layout → Size).
Set every margin to at least 0.5" (more on the inside for thick books), and use "Mirror margins".
Check page numbers, headers and pictures sit inside the margins, then re-export as PDF/X-1a:2001 with fonts embedded.
Re-upload it to your printer and wait for the file review again. If it fails, you start over.

cta.text: SparkPrep measures every page against Lulu's and Barnes & Noble Press's own margins and re-fits the pages for you.

faq.a: At least 0.5" from every trim edge for text, page numbers and headers.

faq.q: What margins does Barnes & Noble Press require?
faq.a: At least 0.5" from every trim edge.
